paragraphs.millac-hamlet-house-bvi87682: This house stands in a hamlet on a plot of 651 m². It has 123 m² of living space and is in excellent condition. Inside you will find stone floors, wooden beams and a fireplace with a pellet burner. There are two bedrooms. The plot also has a barn with water and electricity. It could become extra living space, with permission. The nearest shop, bar and café are 5 km away. L'Isle-Jourdain is 13 km away, Confolens 21 km and Limoges airport 61 km.
paragraphs.ladapeyre-modernised-house-a36890: This house has been fully modernised. It has 133 m² of living space, three bedrooms, two bathrooms and a plot of 2,081 m². It is connected to mains drainage and has its own well. The village has a château, a bakery, a bar and a post office. The lake at Châtelus-Malvaleix, with a bar and a lifeguard in summer, is a 5-minute drive away.
paragraphs.siran-village-house-a42822: This village house has been newly renovated. It has about 60 m² of living space. The ground floor is one open room with exposed stone walls. It has a kitchen with an induction hob and an electric oven, a living and dining area, and a small private terrace. Upstairs there are two double bedrooms and a shower room. The basement has an extra room you could use for storage, a games room or a hobby space. The house is sold furnished. The village is in the Minervois, in the Hérault. Shops and services are within 2 km. The airport is within 50 km.
paragraphs.jumilhac-village-house-bvi85468: This renovated house stands at the edge of the village of Jumilhac-le-Grand, within sight of the château. It has two double bedrooms, each with its original chimney. The chimneys could be reopened. There is a lounge, a kitchen, a bathroom, a cellar (cave), a small back garden and parking off the street. The attic could be converted, with permission. The house has 94 m² of living space on a plot of 193 m². It is in good condition and on mains drainage. It is a short walk to the local shops.
paragraphs.avene-stone-house-a36741: This stone house stands in a hamlet, surrounded by countryside. It has 73 m² of living space. Downstairs there is a large living room with a wood burner, a fitted kitchen and a shower room with a toilet. Upstairs there are three double bedrooms and a bathroom. A staircase leads to a loft. Outside there is a conservatory, a small paved garden and several small cellars with their own outside doors. The Avène thermal spa is a short drive away. It would suit a holiday home, a seasonal rental or a small family home.
paragraphs.saint-laurent-de-ceris-farmhouse-bvi8441: This detached stone farmhouse stands at the edge of a Charente village. It has 93 m² of living space on a plot of 935 m². There are two double bedrooms, a sitting room with a kitchen, a dining room, a second reception room and a bathroom. It also has two large lofts, a cellar and a large attached barn. The garden surrounds the house and there is a driveway. The village bar, bakery and shop are a short walk away. Confolens is nearby, and Limoges airport is about 40 minutes by car.
